anomalies.observed: On the EthernetAndPower sheet, the barrel-jack J2 (Barrel_Jack_Switch) is wired so that its sleeve contact pin 2 joins the BAT+ rail (the same node as USB VBUS, C5 top plate and IC2 pin A2/VIN), while its switch contact pin 3 joins NET0041, which is the battery negative (U9 pin MH2, and the diode U10 side that feeds the BAT- path). anomalies.expected: Per the specification the jack must be wired pin1->BAT+ (center), pin2->GND (sleeve), pin3->BAT-; the normally-closed 2-3 contact then ties the battery return to GND when no plug is inserted and breaks it when a plug is inserted. Pin 2 must NOT be on BAT+.

evidence.quote: Netlist: J4.1->BAT+ (center/positive), J4.2->GND (sleeve), J4.3->BAT-. Since pins 2 and 3 are normally shorted (per the note) ... this means the jack's internal switch keeps the battery's return path connected to GND by default
commit a1d9676 'Meshinger 1.0 rev B WARNING THE DC PLUG PINS ARE WRONG, SHORTS BATTERY!'

EthernetAndPower sheet: J2 'Barrel Jack Switch' pin 2 wire runs to the BAT+ rail shared with J1 VBUS and C5/IC2-VIN; pin 3 wire runs to NET0041 (U9 MH2 battery negative); note '2 and 3 are shorted with no plug'

anomalies.impact: With no DC plug inserted the jack's closed 2-3 contact directly shorts the battery positive (BAT+) to the battery negative (NET0041), exactly the 'SHORTS BATTERY' failure the spec warns about; additionally the battery return is never connected to GND, so the board cannot power up and the cell/holder is exposed to a hard short.

parsed.summary: The board is otherwise a faithful (re-numbered) implementation of the spec, but the DC barrel jack J2 is miswired: its sleeve pin 2 is tied to the BAT+ rail instead of GND, so the normally-closed 2-3 contact shorts BAT+ to the battery-negative net (NET0041) when no plug is inserted, reproducing the documented 'DC plug pins are wrong, shorts battery' fault.
